findings.description: V92 measured under-shorts upper-thigh coverage at 100.0% neutral, 97.2% crouch and 97.3% sit, but direct inspection of front, back, side, three-quarter and all pose renders shows the extended copied shell ending in a clearly jagged/sawtooth edge below the overskirt. In crouch and sit, the shell boundary is visibly discontinuous and reads as protruding unfinished garment geometry. The measurement does not establish acceptable hem or fit.

Direct inspection of sit, crouch and prone renders shows the overskirt side panels forming deep narrow ridges and pointed triangular flaps with an uneven hanging front/back hem. These defects remain visible across posed renders.

Candidate geometry audit remains NO-GO and explicitly marks avatar fit unverified. The pipeline also reports missing smooth-shape-keys evidence. Renders do not establish garment fit, shape-key behavior, UV completion, Unity/VRChat runtime, or release readiness.

nextAction: Keep this prototype rejected. Replace or trim the shell boundary to a deliberate garment hem hidden beneath the overskirt, resolve the overskirt side/hem deformation in posed renders, then rebuild and inspect fresh views. Keep UV marked NOT_CREATED and retain independent fit, rig, Unity/VRChat and release gates.
